tables.name: facial_skin_thickness
rows: zygomatic, oral commissure, mandibular angle, supraorbital, infraorbital
tables.population: Ultrasound cohorts; sample sizes and ancestry not extracted from snippets
tables.notes: Two independent sources agree that facial skin is about 1-2 mm thick; the per-row numbers are single-source snippet values. The two sources measure slightly different things (dermis vs whole skin). Skin is the outermost layer only, not total soft-tissue depth.

tables.notes: Use as broad priors for a layered model, not as measurements. Order 0 is the total. Replace with values from the 1174-adult layer-specific CT study (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42385786/) once extracted. CT/cadaver data are supine and under-represent upright sag over the spaces.
